Deploy the two synthetic CallCenter definitions. Query their IDs in ascending order. Create three AdditionalNumber records named SyntheticN, SyntheticL, SyntheticH using the data API, with null, lower and higher CallCenterId respectively. Re-query Name and CallCenterId to validate the stored values. Query these records at each API version with ORDER BY CallCenterId NULLS FIRST, NULLS LAST, ASC, DESC, and DESC NULLS LAST; map the suffix of each Name to N, L, H. The earlier Apex DML attempt is captured in the neighboring callcenter fixture.
